name: Boost
description: Boost 1.34.1 compiled libraries the 2008-06 client links statically (thread, signals, filesystem, date_time, regex, iostreams with zlib), stock upstream sources.

layers.name: upstream
layers.files: libs/thread/src/*.cpp libs/signals/src/*.cpp libs/filesystem/src/*.cpp libs/date_time/src/gregorian/*.cpp libs/regex/src/*.cpp libs/iostreams/src/zlib.cpp libs/iostreams/src/file_descriptor.cpp libs/iostreams/src/mapped_file.cpp
layers.defines: WIN32 NDEBUG BOOST_ALL_NO_LIB BOOST_THREAD_BUILD_LIB BOOST_SIGNALS_STATIC_LINK BOOST_FILESYSTEM_STATIC_LINK BOOST_DATE_TIME_STATIC_LINK BOOST_REGEX_STATIC_LINK BOOST_IOSTREAMS_NO_LIB
